name: Gravity Chain
design_intent:
ORBIT circuit, slot 6 (diff 4). Lesson: CHAINED SLINGS / MOMENTUM HANDOFF -- escalate g6_slingshot to TWO wells in a row and flow from one to the next without a footing in between. Two black-hole wells, cores BUMPER (body_r 100, tier bumper, lethal_core_r 0, visual black_hole -- non-lethal, exactly the Singularity/Slingshot ruling so this is a FLOW puzzle, not a death puzzle; that is dead_star's job): well A at (600,300) field r1000 g1050, well B at (2800,300) field r1000 g1050. Their fields DON'T overlap -- a ~200px neutral global-down gap (x 1600..1800) sits between them, so the handoff is a committed carry. Start pad (trampoline) far left at center x=-560 (outside A's -400 edge); goal ring on B's far-right rim, center (3900,-320), on a small trampoline pad.

FLIGHT-REQUIRED / movement-tool-per-gap: total start-to-goal run is ~4460px (x -560 to 3900). One boost tank flies only ~2660px, so a naive straight boost across BOTH fields dies well short -- the slings are STRUCTURALLY required, not optional. Route: dive into A, whip around the bumper core, RELEASE toward B (spend a little boost only to tune the exit angle), coast the 200px neutral gap (global-down nudges you screen-down mid-gap -- lead it), get captured by B, sling around B's core, and release up to the goal on B's far rim. Each bumper-core ricochet keeps the ball lively (restitution) but refunds NO fuel (bumper), so momentum management is the whole game. Fall out the bottom of either field = free respawn at the start pad. Bounds frame both r1000 fields (x -400..3800) with side margin and a top that clears the outswing apex.
hint: SLING OUT OF ONE WELL STRAIGHT INTO THE NEXT
